repos.name: Leonxlnx/unlazy
repos.description: Anti-laziness skill for AI agents. Core: the Depth Tree method, which splits a task N layers deep and gives every leaf the full time budget of the whole task, so effort multiplies with depth. Grounded in 2025-2026 research on model laziness, underthinking and premature completion.
repos.one_liner: An innovative framework for AI agents that uses a 'Depth Tree' method to multiply task effort and reasoning depth.
bullets: Implements the Depth Tree algorithm to recursively split complex tasks into N layers.
Allocates the full task time budget to each leaf node to maximize reasoning output.
Designed to combat AI 'laziness' and improve performance on complex, multi-step reasoning tasks.
Provides a structured approach to agentic workflows that require deep, exhaustive analysis.

repos.name: NanoNets/Graft
repos.description: Turn docs into a structured context graph that AI agents read from before working and contribute learnings back to.
repos.one_liner: A system that transforms unstructured documents into a structured context graph for AI agents to read and update.
bullets: Uses a graph-based data structure to maintain relationships between document entities.
Enables bidirectional communication where agents read context and contribute new learnings back to the graph.
Optimizes RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) by providing agents with structured, interconnected knowledge.
Ideal for enterprise knowledge management and long-term agent memory applications.

repos.name: duty1g/x64dbg-mcp-server
repos.description: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) plugin for x64dbg that exposes the debugger's full functionality over HTTP. Connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant and control x64dbg programmatically: set breakpoints, step through code, read memory, dump registers, and more.  Built with Zig — zero dependencies, single-binary output, cros
repos.one_liner: A native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes x64dbg functionality to AI assistants.
bullets: Built in Zig to provide a high-performance bridge between the x64dbg debugger and AI models.
Exposes full debugger control via HTTP, allowing AI agents to perform reverse engineering tasks.
Enables agentic debugging, where an AI can step through code, inspect memory, and analyze crashes autonomously.
Integrates with any MCP-compatible AI assistant for automated security research and software analysis.

repos.name: VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills
repos.description: A curated collection of 1000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and more.
repos.one_liner: A massive, curated repository of 1000+ interoperable skills for modern AI coding agents.
bullets: Provides a standardized library of modular skills compatible with Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
Covers a wide range of operational domains, from infrastructure management to code refactoring.
Serves as a central hub for developers to extend the capabilities of their autonomous coding agents.
Facilitates the rapid deployment of agentic workflows by providing pre-built, community-vetted tools.

repos.name: oblien/openship
repos.one_liner: A self-hosted, open-source deployment platform designed to simplify infrastructure management.
bullets: Built with TypeScript to provide a modern, developer-friendly interface for managing cloud deployments.
Focuses on self-hosting to give teams full control over their infrastructure and data privacy.
Streamlines CI/CD pipelines by automating the deployment process for containerized applications.
Acts as a cost-effective alternative to proprietary PaaS offerings for devops and infrastructure teams.
